# 285_R6FIX.22 — Artifact Registry cleanup policy (BL-122)

## Summary

- **Defect (BL-122, N-A3-5):** the per-stack AR repo had no cleanup policy — unbounded growth, and
  a later blanket cleanup could eat digest-pinned rollback candidates.
- **Design (operator ruling 2026-11-16):** KEEP tagged + KEEP 30 most-recent digests/image +
  DELETE untagged >30d, behind `cleanupPolicyDryRun: true` — policies report-only until a later
  operator apply flips to live.
- Deploy-bound: effective on the next `pulumi up`; dry-run flip is a second operator act.

## Test plan

- [x] `infra/pulumi` `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- [x] Append-only vs `origin/main`, CURRENT STATE schema, gitleaks — clean.
- [ ] Operator `pulumi up` + post-observation dry-run flip (deploy acts, out of this run's scope).
